title: ListOpsAndDepsResponse
description:
Op 1 response: operators and departments registered on the HDM device.

The wire keys are the cryptic `c` / `d` from the spec example; the Rust fields are named for
what they hold.

c.description: Operators registered on the device (wire key `c`).

d.description: Departments registered on the device (wire key `d`).

OperatorInfo.description: Single entry from the operator list.

id.description: Operator's unique numeric ID, used as the cashier code in [`super::session::OperatorLoginRequest`].

deps.description: Unique IDs of departments assigned to this operator.

DepartmentInfo.description: Single entry from the department list.

type.description: Taxation kind. Numeric on the wire; mapped to [`TaxationKind`].
